blocks.text: O'zbek tilida fe'l qo'shimchalar bilan o'zgaradi: ishla**y oladi**, ishla**moqchi**, ishla**yapti**, ishla**gan**. Ingliz tilida esa fe'lning bor-yo'g'i bir necha shakli bor va qaysi biri kerakligini **oldingi so'z** hal qiladi: modal fe'ldan keyin bir shakl, **want** dan keyin boshqa, **am / is / are** dan keyin yana boshqa. Oldingi 50 ta darsda bu shakllarning hammasini ko'rdingiz. Bu dars — ularni bir joyga yig'adigan umumiy xarita: «qaysi so'zdan keyin fe'lning qaysi shakli keladi».

rows: will, can, must ... va do / does / did dan keyin
want, need, have, would like ... dan keyin
am / is / are / was / were dan keyin (Continuous)
have / has dan keyin va majhul nisbatda be dan keyin

blocks.text: Nega bu muhim? O'zbekchada «ishlay olaman», «ishlamoqchiman», «ishlayapman», «ishlaganman» deganda qo'shimchani o'ylamay tanlaymiz. Inglizchada xuddi shu ma'nolar **ikki qismli juftlik** bilan quriladi: **can work**, **want to work**, **am working**, **have worked**. Juftlikning birinchi qismi (yordamchi so'z) ikkinchisining shaklini «buyuradi». Shuning uchun gap tuzayotganda avval yordamchi so'zni aniqlang — fe'l shakli o'zidan-o'zi kelib chiqadi.
1. Asosiy shakl: can swim, will go, did you see

Fe'lning lug'atdagi shakli (to siz) — **asosiy shakl**. U ikki joyda keladi: **modal fe'llardan** keyin (will, would, can, could, must, should, might, may, shall — 27–33-darslar) va **do / does / did** dan keyin (Present Simple va Past Simple ning savol va inkori — 6, 7, 12-darslar). Bu so'zlardan keyin fe'lga hech narsa qo'shilmaydi: na `to`, na `-s`, na `-ed`. Sababi oddiy: zamon va shaxsni yordamchi so'zning o'zi ko'rsatib bo'ldi — **does** da `-s` bor, **did** da o'tgan zamon bor, ikkinchi marta ko'rsatish shart emas.
2. to + fe'l: want to go, need to buy

Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l **to** bilan keladi: **want to** go, **need to** buy, **have to** work, **would like to** see, **try to** understand, **decide to** stay, **hope to** find. O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha «-moqchi», «-ish kerak», «-ishga» mos keladi: bor**moqchiman**, sotib ol**ishim kerak**, tushun**ishga** harakat qilyapman. **to** dan keyin ham faqat asosiy shakl turadi: to **go** — hech qachon «to going» yoki «to went» emas. Qaysi fe'llardan keyin **to**, qaysilaridan keyin **-ing** kelishi — keyingi, 52-darsda.

items.text: I **want to sleep** for ten hours.
Lola **is trying to understand** the new rules.

blocks.text: **am / is / are** va **was / were** dan keyin fe'l **-ing** shaklida keladi — bu Continuous zamonlar: Present Continuous (hozirgi davomli zamon, 3-dars) va Past Continuous (o'tgan davomli zamon, 13-dars). O'zbekchadagi «-yapti» va «-ayotgan edi» ga to'g'ri keladi: ishla**yapti**, ishla**yotgan edi**. -ing boshqa joylarda ham uchraydi: **go** dan keyin (go swimming — 55-dars) va **enjoy**, **finish** kabi fe'llardan keyin (enjoy reading — 52-dars). -ing qo'shilganda imlo biroz o'zgarishi mumkin:

rows: Qisqa fe'l: unli + undosh → undosh ikkilanadi

items.text: We **were having** dinner when you phoned.
items.translation: Siz qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda biz kechki ovqat **qilayotgan edik**.

blocks.text: Fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3, past participle) ikki joyda kerak. Birinchisi — **have / has** dan keyin: Present Perfect (15-dars) — I **have finished**, she **has gone**. Ikkinchisi — **be** dan keyin: majhul nisbat (21–22-darslar) — it **is made**, it **was built**. To'g'ri fe'llarda V3 o'tgan zamon shakli bilan bir xil (`-ed`: worked, played), noto'g'ri fe'llarda esa uni yodlash kerak (24-dars, to'liq ro'yxat — 117-dars). O'zbekchada V3 ga ko'pincha «-gan» (ishla**gan**) yoki majhul «-il / -in» (qur**il**gan, yasa**l**gan) mos keladi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I can to swim.» → **I can swim.** (modal fe'ldan keyin to yo'q); «She can swims.» → **She can swim.** (`-s` faqat can ga ham, fe'lga ham qo'shilmaydi); «I want go home.» → **I want to go home.** (want dan keyin to shart); «Did you saw him?» → **Did you see him?** (o'tgan zamonni did ko'rsatdi); «I am work in a bank.» → **I work in a bank.** yoki **I'm working ...** (am dan keyin faqat -ing yoki V3); «He has went.» → **He has gone.** (have dan keyin V2 emas, V3).

Eslab qolish — «oldingi so'zga qarang»: **modal** yoki **do / does / did** → asosiy shakl; **want / need / have / would like** → **to** + fe'l; **be** → **-ing** (faol) yoki **V3** (majhul); **have** → **V3**. Bitta gapda bir nechta juftlik bo'lishi mumkin: She **has** **decided** **to** **study** — has → V3, decided → to + fe'l.

examples.title: Base form after **can**, **will**, **must** ...
examples.description: Modal fe'llardan (can, could, will, would, must, should, might, may, shall) keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi: unga to ham, `-s` ham, `-ing` ham qo'shilmaydi.

sentences.text: My little brother **can swim** very well.
Don't worry, I **will call** you this evening.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, bugun kechqurun sizga **qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: You **must wear** a helmet on a motorbike.
Aziz **should see** a doctor about his back.
sentences.translation: Aziz beli og'riyotgani uchun shifokorga **ko'rinishi kerak**.

sentences.text: It **might rain** later, so take an umbrella.
sentences.translation: Keyinroq yomg'ir **yog'ishi mumkin**, soyabon olib oling.

sentences.text: **Could** you **open** the window, please?
Sarah **can't come** to the party because she's working.
sentences.translation: Sara ziyofatga **kela olmaydi**, chunki u ishlayapti.

sentences.text: **Shall** we **take** a taxi or walk to the station?
In Tashkent you **can buy** fresh bread on every corner.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda har burchakda issiq non **sotib olsa bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: The manager said that we **may leave** early today.

examples.title: Base form after **do** / **does** / **did**
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple ning savol va inkorida yordamchi fe'l (do, does, did) o'zgaradi, asosiy fe'l esa doim asosiy shaklda qoladi: does she **work**, didn't **go**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **speak** English at work?
My father **doesn't drink** coffee in the evening.
Where **did** you **buy** that jacket?
Madina **didn't go** to the gym yesterday.
**Does** your sister **live** in Samarkand or in Bukhara?
We **don't watch** TV much — we prefer books.
sentences.translation: Biz televizorni kam **ko'ramiz** — kitobni afzal ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: What time **did** the film **start** last night?
Tom **didn't understand** the question, so he asked again.
sentences.translation: Tom savolni **tushunmadi**, shuning uchun qayta so'radi.

sentences.text: **Did** Emma **pass** her driving test? — Yes, she did.
Why **doesn't** Bekzod ever **answer** his phone?
sentences.translation: Nega Bekzod hech qachon telefoniga **javob bermaydi**?

examples.title: **to** + verb: **want to**, **need to**, **have to**
examples.description: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin to + asosiy shakl keladi: want to, need to, have to, would like to, try to, decide to, hope to. Bunday fe'llarning to'liq ro'yxati — 52-darsda.

sentences.text: I **want to learn** Spanish next year.
We **need to buy** some milk and eggs.
sentences.translation: Biroz sut va tuxum **sotib olishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has to get up** at six every morning.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza har kuni ertalab soat oltida **turishi kerak**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **like to come** to dinner on Friday?
James **is trying to fix** his bike in the garage.
After the meeting they **decided to have** lunch together.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishdan keyin ular birga tushlik **qilishga qaror qilishdi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **doesn't want to move** to the city.
You **don't have to bring** anything — we've got everything.
sentences.translation: Hech narsa **olib kelishingiz shart emas** — bizda hammasi bor.

sentences.text: Last summer Bekzod **learnt to drive**, and now he drives to work.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Bekzod **mashina haydashni o'rgandi**, endi ishga mashinada boradi.

sentences.text: Emma **hopes to find** a job in London after university.
sentences.translation: Emma universitetdan keyin Londondan ish **topishga umid qiladi**.

examples.title: **-ing** after **am** / **is** / **are** / **was** / **were**
examples.description: be fe'lidan keyin -ing shakli keladi: Present Continuous (hozir) va Past Continuous (o'sha paytda). O'zbekchadagi «-yapti» va «-ayotgan edi».

sentences.text: Be quiet — the baby **is sleeping**.
Madina, **are** you **listening** to me or to your music?
I**'m reading** a very good book about Samarkand.
The children **aren't doing** their homework — they**'re playing**.
What **were** you **doing** when the lights went out?
When I called, Sarah **was having** a shower.
sentences.translation: Men qo'ng'iroq qilganimda Sara **dush qabul qilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: It **wasn't raining** when we left the house.
This week my parents **are staying** with us in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta ota-onam Toshkentda bizning uyda **turishyapti**.

sentences.text: Look! Two men **are running** after the bus.
sentences.translation: Qarang! Ikki kishi avtobus ortidan **yugurib ketyapti**.

sentences.text: We **were driving** to Bukhara when the car broke down.
sentences.translation: Mashina buzilib qolganda biz Buxoroga **ketayotgan edik**.

examples.title: **have** / **has** + V3: Present Perfect
examples.description: have / has dan keyin fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3) keladi: worked, gone, done, seen. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-di» yoki «-gan».

sentences.text: I**'ve finished** my work for today.
**Have** you ever **been** to London?
Madina **has lost** her keys again.
We **haven't seen** Aziz since his wedding.
Somebody **has eaten** all the biscuits!
My brother **has never driven** a car in a big city.
sentences.translation: Akam hech qachon katta shaharda mashina **haydamagan**.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **worked** at the hospital?
Tom **has already done** the washing-up, so you can relax.
sentences.translation: Tom idishlarni allaqachon **yuvib bo'ldi**, siz dam olavering.

sentences.text: The price of bread **has gone** up this year.
Sorry, I **haven't written** the report yet — I'll do it tomorrow.

examples.title: **be** + V3: passive (**is made**, **was built**)
examples.description: be dan keyin V3 — majhul nisbat: harakatni kim qilgani muhim emas. O'zbekchadagi «-il / -in» (qurilgan, tayyorlanadi).

sentences.text: This cheese **is made** in a small village.
The Registan **was built** many centuries ago.
English **is spoken** in many countries.
Our flat **was cleaned** before we arrived.
sentences.translation: Biz kelishimizdan oldin kvartiramiz **tozalab qo'yilgan edi**.

sentences.text: **Were** you **invited** to Madina's birthday party?
Letters **aren't delivered** on Sundays.
My phone **was stolen** on the bus yesterday.
Breakfast **is served** from seven to ten in the hotel.
Hundreds of photos **are taken** at every wedding.
When **was** this bridge **opened**? — In 2015, I think.

examples.title: Different forms in one sentence
examples.description: Bitta gapda fe'lning bir nechta shakli: har bir fe'l oldidagi so'zga qarang — u fe'lning shaklini belgilaydi.

sentences.text: I **can't go** today, but I **want to go** tomorrow.
Bekzod **isn't working** now — he**'s worked** ten hours today.
We **didn't eat** at home because we **wanted to try** the new café.
sentences.translation: Uyda **ovqatlanmadik**, chunki yangi kafeni **sinab ko'rmoqchi edik**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **done** your homework, or **are** you still **doing** it?
She **wants to write** a book, and now she **is writing** the first chapter.
Emma **was sleeping** when the parcel **was delivered**.
You **should rest** — you**'ve been** ill all week.
My car **is being repaired**, so I **have to take** the bus.
Dilnoza **has gone** to the market — she **needs to buy** some fruit.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bozorga **ketgan** — biroz meva **sotib olishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Where **did** you **put** the keys? I **can't find** them anywhere.

examples.title: Dialogue: plans for the weekend
examples.description: Suhbatda fe'l shakllari aralash: Continuous, to + fe'l, modal fe'l + asosiy shakl, Present Perfect.

sentences.text: — What **are** you **doing** this weekend, Aziz?
sentences.translation: — Bu dam olish kunlari nima **qilyapsan**, Aziz?

sentences.text: — I **want to visit** my aunt in Samarkand.
— Nice! **Have** you ever **travelled** there by train?
— No, I usually **drive**, but this time I**'d like to take** the fast train.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, odatda mashinada **boraman**, lekin bu safar tezyurar poyezdda **bormoqchiman**.

sentences.text: — You **should buy** your ticket today — the trains are often full.
sentences.translation: — Chiptani bugun **olishing kerak** — poyezdlar ko'pincha to'la bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — I **tried to buy** one online, but the website **wasn't working**.
sentences.translation: — Internetdan **olishga harakat qildim**, lekin sayt **ishlamayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: — **Did** you **call** the station?
— Not yet. I**'ll call** them after lunch.
— My cousin **has worked** there for years — he **can help** you.
sentences.translation: — Amakivachcham u yerda ko'p yildan beri **ishlaydi** — senga **yordam bera oladi**.

sentences.text: — Really? That's great — **could** you **send** me his number?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Zo'r — uning raqamini menga **yuborib bera olasanmi**?
